answer: Standing is audited against its own past. Enrolment freezes a dossier: three published figures and one named procedure. Every few epochs a seeded probe asks for those details back under a rotated salt, so a borrowed answer cannot be recited twice. A contradiction voids the epoch; three in ten burn the stake. A farm of 1,000 clones needs writers defending 1,000 histories, roughly 50 paid hours per epoch, near $1,250 every six hours. One miner answers from memory in a minute. A jade seal pressed twice carries the same chip, and a sable brush leaves one bent bristle under the lantern.
